Raised by CodeRabbit on #84. pm-github's reusable sync and closeout workflows only run an npm script from `npm-project-dir` after the tracker change. pm-rust's callers use `tests/oracle`, which has no scripts, so both post-change scripts are disabled. A closeout PR that closes items therefore ships an unchanged `CHANGELOG.md`, and the dispatched `ci.yml` (`just release-check` → `just changelog-check`) rejects it.

Options:
1. Add `"changelog:full"` to `tests/oracle/package.json`, delegating to the single source of truth: `just changelog-full` from the repository root. This needs `just` on the runner, so either the reusable workflow installs it, or a node wrapper reproduces the recipe from the justfile constants.
2. Add an optional pm-github input that installs a named tool (pinned action) before the post-change script.

Until this is fixed, a closeout PR needs a manual `just changelog-full` push.
Gated sync/closeout PRs cannot regenerate CHANGELOG.md because the changelog recipe lives in the justfile
